customManagers.description: Tool versions in contract.env (KEY=value below a '# renovate:' marker), read by scripts/build.sh

packageRules.description: Kotlin follows the Spring Boot BOM: KOTLIN_VERSION must equal kotlin.version of SPRING_BOOT_VERSION (4.1.1 -> 2.3.21) - the jar is compiled with it, the backend runs it with the BOM's kotlin-stdlib. Raise both together by hand.
